name: Chilli prawn linguine
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical BBC Good Food pasta recipe scale (280 g dry linguine + 360 g prawns for 4 adult servings).
Total active + passive time conservatively summed from explicit instruction timings (30 s garlic, 3 min prawns, 3 min tomatoes) plus standard pasta boil (~10 min) and prep steps.
King prawns classified as shellfish and fish-adjacent allergen.
No barley/rye; gluten-free set false due to wheat pasta.
No explicit tree nuts, peanuts, soy, sesame, or eggs; left null.
Pescatarian true because only seafood is the animal product and no meat.
instructions:
Mix the dressing ingredients in a small bowl and season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions. Add the sugar snap peas for the last minute or so of cooking time.

Meanwhile, heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan, toss in the garlic and chilli and cook over a fairly gentle heat for about 30 seconds without letting the garlic brown. Tip in the prawns and cook over a high heat, stirring frequently, for about 3 minutes until they turn pink.

Add the tomatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, for 3 minutes until they just start to soften. Drain the pasta and sugar snaps well, then toss into the prawn mixture. Tear in the basil leaves, stir, and season with salt and pepper.

Serve with salad leaves drizzled with the lime dressing, and warm crusty bread.

ingredients.name: Linguine Pasta
ingredients.assumptions: Standard dry durum wheat linguine; values are for uncooked weight as listed.

ingredients.name: Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients.assumptions: Raw sugar snap peas; typical package size matches listed 200 g.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons olive oil (standard 13.5 g per tbsp).

ingredients.name: Garlic Clove
ingredients.assumptions: 2 average garlic cloves chopped (≈3 g each).

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large fresh red chili (≈20 g whole, edible portion).

ingredients.name: King Prawns
ingredients.assumptions: 24 medium-large skinned raw king prawns (≈15 g each edible weight).

ingredients.name: Basil Leaves
ingredients.assumptions: Handful of fresh basil leaves (typical 10–20 g; used 15 g).

ingredients.name: Lettuce
ingredients.assumptions: Mixed salad leaves / lettuce for serving (plausible side portion).

ingredients.name: Bread
ingredients.assumptions: Warm crusty bread 'to serve' (plausible 2 thin slices / 60 g total).

ingredients.name: Fromage Frais
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons fromage frais (standard 15 g per tbsp).

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: Grated zest of 2 limes (edible zest only ≈10 g each).

ingredients.name: Caster Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 2 teaspoons caster sugar (standard 4 g per tsp).
